notes.title: Saints & Sinners Anniversary Sale
notes.content:
It has been a long journey for this VR dive into The Walking Dead universe. From [i]Chapter 1[/i]'s launch back in 2020, to its [i]Meatgrinder[/i] and [i]Aftershocks[/i] expansions, to each new platform it came to afterwards, and now to the upcoming release of [i]Chapter 2[/i] on Steam and beyond, it has been amazing to see just how far [i]Saints & Sinners[/i] has come.

[previewyoutube=zuAAEcIcIfM;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate, we want to make it even easier to jump into the action, in more ways than one.

Alongside the now ongoing Anniversary Sale here on Steam, check out the video above for tons of new details regarding what's next for the series, including release date information, a new weapon coming to the series, and expanded save file importing features. 

If you know other survivors who haven't started their journey just yet, let them know there's no better time to join the tour.

notes.title: Retribution Release Date News and Info
notes.content:
It's good to see you again, Tourists.

With the release of [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Chapter 2: Retribution[/i] on Meta Headsets, and the launch date announced for PSVR2, players on PC have been waiting to hear news on when the PCVR version of the game would officially launch. We always try to get games in your hands as fast as possible, but sometimes we need to take our time to make sure that your game will work properly and fully utilize the features of your platform of choice. To ensure that the PCVR version of the game looks and runs at the highest possible quality, we've made the decision to move its release from December 2022 to February 2023. We discussed this some days ago, but we should have posted here as well, so sorry for the last minute nature of this post.

We thank you for your patience, and hope to see you return to undead New Orleans in early 2023.

notes.title: Prepare For Retribution
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=T4bkDh8OAaY;full][/previewyoutube]

Your journey isn't over, Tourists.

We are proud to reveal our first major teaser trailer for [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Chapter 2: Retribution[/i] alongside our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1947500/The_Walking_Dead_Saints__Sinners__Chapter_2_Retribution/]Wishlist Page for the Chapter 2![/url] Check out both to get your first major taste of what's in store for the next step of our undead tour through NOLA.

To celebrate, we are also holding a sale from the 20th to the 29th, 20% off both the Standard and Tourist editions of the game. 

Stay tuned for more info to come, and thank you all for your continued support of [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners.[/i]

notes.title: Grab a bucket - The PS Plus line-up for November has been leaked
notes.content:
According to a post on Dealabs, a community forum where information is posted and verified by dedicated moderators, has posted leaked details of November’s PlayStation Plus line-up. According to this leak, the four of the six games included are as follows:

  • The Walking Dead: Saints and Sinners (PlayStation VR)
  • Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning (PS4)
  • First Class Trouble (PS4 / PS5)
  • Knockout City (PS4 / PS5)

First Class Trouble has been available on Steam in Early Access since April 8 2021, and an announcement trailer for the PS4 and PS5 versions was released only a month ago. The game has yet to have a full release date, but if these leaks are true it would mean that the complete game must be available sometime between now and November 2.

notes.title: Aftershocks Launch, Weekend Sale, and New Aftershocks Features
notes.content:
Hey there Tourists,

The [i]Aftershocks[/i] update is finally here, and as such we at Skydance Interactive want to make sure that you have the best experience you can have with it. Today, we would like to reveal one such way we are working to make the experience even better for our players, alongside some news and details that may be relevant to you.

[b]Upcoming Quick Start Feature[/b]
While Aftershocks is intended to be played after you have reached the credits, we understand that some players may find themselves without a completed save file and not wanting to play through the entirety of the game again just to see the what's new. 

To satisfy these players, [b]we plan to implement a quick start option[/b] that will allow you to jump straight into the [i]Aftershocks[/i] content without finishing a playthrough. This feature will be implemented in a patch following shortly after the initial update, so if you do not have a post-game save file yet, you can choose to wait for this feature. 

[b]Weekend Sale[/b]
We also plan to have a Weekend Sale alongside the update, starting today and ending on September 27th, so even more tourists can start their walker slaying journey while veteran players continue their own. If you haven't experience [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners[/i] before, here's your chance to jump straight into the action.

[b]Important information for HTC Vive Users[/b]
Finally, we have [b]a note to all HTC VIVE Users:[/b] Some users may find some difficulty in how a new flashlight focused feature is currently implemented mechanically. Expect tweaks to this system to come with a patch in the days that follow the update.

We thank you again for all your support, and are very excited for you all to enjoy what Aftershocks has to offer.

notes.title: New Release Date for Aftershocks + FAQ!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=djufjNlSABw;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for your patience, Tourists.

We know that delays are always tough. For our first simultaneous cross-platform content release, the team has been working hard at getting all versions of the update to live up to our standards.

The good news is that we have a new launch date for [i]Aftershocks[/i], [b]September 23rd! [/b] 

The content itself is playable and practically complete, but we are trying to smooth out as many rough edges as we can find. We have been humbled by how many of you have enjoyed the game, and [i]Aftershocks[/i] won’t be the end of the content coming to [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners.[/i] We will reveal more on this in the coming months.

Still, since September is over a month away, and fans are clamoring to know more about [i]Aftershocks[/i], we thought we would provide an FAQ / feature breakdown to hold you over, and help you prepare for the time being. 

- - -

[b]What exactly is the [i]Aftershocks[/i] update?[/b]
[i]Aftershocks[/i] is the next free update for [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners[/i], expanding the campaign of the game with a new set of post-ending missions, supply caches to find, and a new set of challenges to test your survival skills.

[b]Is it coming to all platforms?[/b]
Yes! The [i]Aftershocks[/i] update will be coming the same day to all VR platforms that [i]Saints & Sinners[/i] has been released on. 

[b]How do I play the new content?[/b]
You will have to have reached the ending of the game’s storyline first before the new content unlocks. Once you have officially entered the post-game (i.e. after the credits) keep your radio tuned to channel 47, you may find that it’s worth your while. 

[b]What does the new update include?[/b]
Alongside the new missions, the update includes a number of Reserve Caches to find that are filled with late game supplies and unique collectibles, new enemy layouts and scenarios, a new type of environmental hazard to watch out for, and a few extra surprises you’ll find throughout your playthrough. 

[b]Will there be new areas in [i]Aftershocks[/i]?[/b]
You will be returning to old locations during your time in [i]Aftershocks[/i], but each mission drastically changes, and makes it more challenging, what you’ve grown accustomed to expect. Put simply, the areas are familiar but what you’ll encounter within them won’t be.

[b]Will there be new weapons/items in [i]Aftershocks[/i]?[/b]
While your walker slaying arsenal won’t be drastically changed by this new update, there may be a new tool that will change the way you interact with the world of [i]Saints & Sinners[/i]...beyond that, we can’t say much. 

[b]How Long is the new update?[/b]
On a standard playthrough the update should provide around 4 to 6 hours of new content.

[b]How big will the download for the new update be?[/b]
The download size for the update will depend on which version of the game you are playing, but our current estimations are as follows...
[list]
[*] PCVR - 31.3GB
[*] Oculus Quest 1/2 - 6.73GB
[*] PSVR - 9.67GB
[/list]  
More space may be necessary than listed for the initial download, but the total update after installation will be close to the sizes listed above.

[b]When is the [i]Aftershocks[/i] update even coming out?[/b]
Our new planned release date for the update will be September 23rd, 2021.

notes.title: An Announcement Regarding Aftershocks
notes.content:
Hello Tourists,

We have been spending a lot of time in the past weeks getting our game ready for the announced Aftershocks update. However, technical issues have arisen which we did not anticipate. Launching on multiple platforms and upgrading to a new engine version is tricky to say the least.

The bottom line is that we do not want to ship without knowing that you can access the Aftershocks update on whatever supported VR hardware you are using and have an experience up to our standards. As such we have made the hard decision to delay this update initially planned for May 20.	 

This delay may push the launch by several weeks. We know having a definitive answer is important, so we will reach back out on our social channels once we have a final date we are confident we can hit.

Thank you for your support and patience. 

-The Skydance Interactive Team

notes.title: Get ready for Aftershocks: New campaign content coming to Saints & Sinners!

Your tour through undead New Orleans isn't over just yet. On May 20th jump back on your skiff and return to the deadly world of [i]The Walking Dead[/i] in this free post-campaign adventure, [i][b]Aftershocks.[/b][/i]

New missions, stories, collectibles, and survival tools await you on this dangerous new journey. This is only the start of the threats lurking just below the surface, so stay tuned for more updates in the future.

notes.title: Tourists Rejoice! The Meatgrinder arrives!
notes.content:
The bells have tolled. The dead are swarming. And you’re the only living thing in sight. It’s time for you to face [b]The Meatgrinder.[/b] In this new update to [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners,[/i] you’ll be able to battle the undead in ways you never have before. 

Face relentless waves of walkers in [b]The Trial,[/b] a new mode with all game weapons unlockable, new stamina and health boosting items, and a deadly challenge where your wits, skills, and whatever you can craft in the midst of the chaos will be your staunchest allies. Choose your arena, score big points through creative kills, and see how long you can survive. 

Do you want a more casual tour of New Orleans? Try out the new [b]difficulty option[/b] "Story Mode" in campaign for a new take on your undead adventure.

Finally, prove yourself as an apocalyptic samurai with the new katana weapon aspect: [b]‘Absolution’.[/b] If you are going to slice and dice those who dare challenge you, you might as well do it in style, and forgive their sins.

Alongside all of this, expect bug fixes and tweaks to better improve the [i]Saints & Sinners[/i] experience.

notes.title: The Walking Dead: Saints and Sinners getting quick-fire horde mode in July
notes.content:
Developer Skydance Interactive's celebrated VR zombie smasher The Walking Dead: Saints and Sinners is ratcheting up the tempo a little next month with the introduction of new arcade-style horde mode, arriving as part of its next content expansion, the Meatgrinder Update.

In its ordinary guise, The Walking Dead: Saints and Sinners serves up a richly atmospheric and genuinely nerve-shredding slice of sandbox-style undead mayhem, setting players loose among the zombie-infested, semi-flooded streets of New Orleans and then arming them with a fine selection of tools that just might help them make it to safety unscathed.

Eurogamer's Ian Higton whimpered his way through the experience with admirable determination when he faced the zombie apocalypse back in January.

notes.title: Release notes for Hotfix #2 - The Walking Dead Saints & Sinners, CL 157393
notes.content:
[b]For everyone:[/b][list]
[*] [b]Handgun/Pistol angle adjustments, two-handed grips on one-handed firearms now stay level[/b][/list]
[b]...and for those who have demanded it:[/b][list]
[*] [b]An Alpha version of Physical Crouching![/b][/list]
This an early Work-in-Progress and there are definitely some flaws, but the early results are so promising we wanted to share it now.  Also, we want to ask your help to make it better. So...

The feature is still in active development, and you'll have to hack the INI to expose it.

Here's how:[list][*] Open your [b]GameUserSettings.ini[/b] file which in typical Windows 10 installs will be here:
[b]C:\\Users\\[i]{username}[/i]\\AppData\\Local\\TWD\\Saved\\Config\\WindowsNoEditor\\GameUserSettings.ini[/b]
[list][*][b]Note[/b]: [i]The AppData folder may be hidden, but you can reveal it via Folder Options from your Start Menu[/i][/list]
[*] FInd the line that reads: 
[b]/Script/TWD.TWDGameUserSettings[/b]
[*] Right below that, insert the following: [b]bPhysicalCrouchEnabled=True[/b]
[*] Run the game, give it a whirl.[/list] 
[b]Some Caveats[/b]:[list][*] Start each play session by hitting [b]ResetHMD/Pause[/b] from a comfortable standing position.  If anything gets weird, do it again.
[*] If you find you have to crouch too far or not far enough you can edit [b]CrouchDistance=32.000[/b] (found in the same file), to any number you find comfortable.  Be sure to post any mods you make that make it feel better.[/list]
[b]Known Flaws[/b]: [list][*]Sometimes pops a bit when entering a crawlspace.  We're already working on it.[*] You can find some bits of level geometry that pop you down when you crawl near them.[/list][/list]
Post about it!  Tell us what's working and what's not, post videos of awkward moments, or of beautiful ones.  Everything we hear helps us make it better, and believe me [u][b]we are listening[/b][/u]!

Last, we want to give a huge shout-out to everyone who pushed us to make this happen.  You were right - it's going to be amazing!  With your help, we'll get it there.

notes.title: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners is a surprisingly fleshed out VR nightmare
notes.content:
I would definitely die in a zombie apocalypse. That s my main takeaway from The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners, a VR tie-in that launched on Steam yesterday. A full-bodied control scheme demands you swing axes with both hands to put enough weight behind your attack, and knives and screwdrivers have to be buried into scalps with committed plunges; half an hour of whacking walkers has me out of puff, struggling to hide my poor fitness from the Skydance Interactive developers spectating my demo.

And that s before you consider the smaller, fumbling errors: accidentally dropping my only gun while shimmying up a drain pipe; filling my backpack with scavenged pillows instead of bandages and food; attempting to throw a bottle at a zombie, only to smash it at my feet and ring the dinner bell for every deadhead in the vicinity. Yes, in an actual zombie nightmare, I wouldn t make it beyond the pilot episode. All these errors are captured in my impressions video below, balanced out with some developer play, too, to see how it s meant to work.

notes.content:
Only a few more days before The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners releases, and we are incredibly excited for everyone to finally get their hands on the game. There is still
time to pre-purchase the the standard, Tourist, or [url=https://walking-dead-saints-sinners.xsollasitebuilder.com/]Tower editions[/url] of the game, so if you have not already, check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916840/The_Walking_Dead_Saints__Sinners/]store page[/url] now! Please note, The Sheriff bonus weapon and recipe will not be paired with the standard edition post-launch. However, the bonus material of the Tourist and Tower editions will remain the same after the game launches.

We also have a brief update regarding language support. While French, German, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Japanese, Korean, and Portuguese (European and Brazilian) are still planned to be supported, at launch [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners[/i] will have full language support for English only. Support for additional languages (interface and subtitles) will be coming at a later date. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Finally, we would like thank everyone who participated in our [url=https://gleam.io/lPeS9/the-walking-dead-saints-sinners?Source=Email]giveaway contest.[/url] There are still 40 hours left, so if you haven't already and you're feeling lucky, enter now! Winners of our various prizes, including gift cards, Oculus Rift S and Oculus Quest headsets, and a VR ready PC, will be announced soon, so stay tuned.
